claims.text: Fever with pain behind the eyes is a recognised early dengue presentation.
You are currently inside an active dengue cluster.

response.action_text: See a doctor today. A polyclinic or a GP is appropriate.
escalation_criteria: Go to an A&E if you develop severe abdominal pain, persistent vomiting, bleeding gums or black stool.
Call 995 for chest pain, breathlessness at rest, confusion or fainting.
Come back to this if your temperature has not settled in three days.
